nodes.statement: One bearer candidate, movement/contact event, selected carrier, named consumer, delivery/read windows and partial distal/motor envelopes are fixed before comparison.
nodes.scope: One declared episode; not whole-organism sensory absence or complete-organizational equality.
nodes.quantifier: One carrier-consumer-window tuple at a time.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Changing consumer, carrier or post-hoc window invalidates the comparison.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Copy/switch cases force active instance and window binding.

nodes.statement: Transduction/delivery, central arrival, aggregate consumer state and actual named-consumer read are distinct coordinates.
nodes.quantifier: Every condition in the EIP package.
nodes.all_premises: EIP:EPISODE_CONTRACT plus predeclared instruments and interventions.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A validated direct causal readout could collapse evidential steps, but not by stipulation.

nodes.statement: Ordinary delivery-arrival-update-output evidence does not identify named-consumer read while an alternative writer is uncontrolled.
nodes.quantifier: All rows under the declared observation map.
nodes.all_premises: EIP:EPISODE_CONTRACT and EIP:TWO_LEVEL_EVIDENCE jointly, U=(S AND G) OR X.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A valid exclusive intervention may identify G; no biological installation follows.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Redundant-writer twins fix every ordinary observation while varying G.

nodes.statement: For S=1 and independently secured X=0, U identifies G only with correct interface, selectivity, timing, sole-writer and faithful-readout premises.
nodes.scope: Exclusive-probe subdomain; not a general neural-identification theorem.
nodes.all_premises: EIP:C1 plus S=1, X=0, validated interface and readout.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Hidden writers, off-target effects, common causes and latency mismatch defeat the inference.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Exclusive probe states how to defeat the redundant-writer twin.

nodes.statement: A read/no-read contrast changes the selected relation even under matched distal output; effort, attention, EMG and other sensory changes are contingent empirical nuisances, not logical consequences of the model.
nodes.scope: Complete organization versus declared partial match.
nodes.all_premises: EIP:EPISODE_CONTRACT, actual G contrast and complete-organization semantics.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Real human interventions may cause many correlated changes that the logic does not settle.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Matched-output exoskeleton isolates partial equality from causal lineage.

nodes.statement: Only after independent actual-bearer, complete-signature, constitutive-relation and target-semantic admission may a read-relation change be interpreted through UCT C1; no H, agency, ownership or basal-experience threshold follows.
nodes.all_premises: Actual token, complete signature, constitutive relation, target semantics and A:C1.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Instrumentation can be accurate while phenomenal direction and bearer admission remain open.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Ancestor/formation prevents a new basal gate.

rules.binding: same carrier, consumer, event, windows and observation map
rules.joint_witness: All eight rows in model.py, including delivered-carrier redundant-writer twins.

rules.binding: same delivered carrier and named consumer with X independently excluded
rules.alternative_route_semantics: No route from arrival or output alone.
rules.joint_witness: S=1 exclusive-probe rows; physical validation remains absent.

rules.binding: one actual token with complete signature and independently admitted target semantics
rules.alternative_route_semantics: C1 remains axiomatic; instruments do not establish H.

adoption_note: Disabled candidate only; no completed map version or premise truth is changed.
